# this is the build file for project 
# it is autogenerated by the xmake build system.
# do not edit by hand.

# project
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
project(gobang-server LANGUAGES CXX)

# target
add_executable(gobang-server "")
set_target_properties(gobang-server PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "gobang-server")
set_target_properties(gobang-server PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/windows/x64/release")
target_include_directories(gobang-server PRIVATE
    .
    lib/openjson
)
target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-m64>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-m64>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-DNDEBUG>
)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE /EHsc)
elseif(Clang)
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE -fexceptions)
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE -fcxx-exceptions)
elseif(Gcc)
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE -fexceptions)
endif()
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O2>)
else()
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE -O3)
endif()
if(MSVC)
else()
    target_compile_options(gobang-server PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden)
endif()
if(MSVC)
    set_property(TARGET gobang-server PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()
target_link_options(gobang-server PRIVATE
    -m64
)
target_sources(gobang-server PRIVATE
    gobangserver.cpp
    main.cpp
    tcpserver.cpp
    lib/openjson/openjson.cpp
)
